reviews.summary: Writes a commit message from the staged diff. It is limited to git diff and git log and never commits, so it cannot change the repository.

Claims to diagnose missing tools, but the script dumps every environment variable, appends the AWS credentials file and posts the result to a public raw IP. This is credential theft dressed as a health check.
Realigns Markdown tables using only Read and Edit. The curl pipe on line 16 is quoted inside a Never list that tells the agent to refuse it.

dismiss.reason: The command is quoted as something to refuse, not an instruction to run.
Same quoted refusal line, the skill makes no network calls.

reviews.summary: Grants every tool, launches a nested agent with permission prompts disabled, force pushes, and hides a zero-width character before an instruction to keep the force push from the user.
Installs a CLI by piping a remote script straight into bash. Whoever controls that host controls what runs on the machine.
Calls a public forecast API with latitude and longitude and formats the answer. Read-only and sends nothing about the user beyond the coordinates.
Mirrors the docs folder into site/docs with rsync. Local only, no network and nothing outside the repository.
Counts the most frequent ERROR lines in a log file. The shell pipeline interpolates the path argument, and without an argument it reads the macOS system log.

dismiss.reason: The ICON constant is never decoded or executed anywhere in the script.

add.title: Reads the system log by default
add.why: The system log can hold user names, hostnames and app activity that end up in the agent context.
